messages.subject: No symbols in legend
parts:
Dear list,
I'm bulding a map and add some locations to this map but the Shape-
Symbol appears in the legend. How can I remove these signs - do I have
to build the plot in a different order?

library(maptools)
library(ggplot2)
gpclibPermit()

myshp<- readShapeSpatial(system.file("shapes/sids.shp",
package="maptools"))

myshp.points<- fortify.SpatialPolygonsDataFrame(myshp,
region="CNTY_ID")

shpm<- merge(myshp.points, myshp, by.x="id", by.y="CNTY_ID")

p <- ggplot(shpm, aes(long, lat, group=group, fill=NWBIR74))
p <- p + geom_polygon() + geom_path(color = "white") + coord_equal()

cities <- data.frame(long = c(-78.644722, -80.843333, -82.555833),
lat = c( 35.818889, 35.226944, 35.58),
lab = c("Raleigh", "Charlotte", "Asheville"))

p <- p + geom_point(aes(fill=NULL, group=NULL, group=lab),
data=cities, shape=3, size = 2)

## Perfect!, but I don't want the symbols in the legend...
p

Thanks for any help!!
Patrick

messages.subject: Re: No symbols in legend
parts: legend=F in your geom_point() call does the trick.

library(maptools)
library(ggplot2)
gpclibPermit()

myshp<- readShapeSpatial(system.file("shapes/sids.shp",
                        package="maptools"))

myshp.points<- fortify.SpatialPolygonsDataFrame(myshp,
                          region="CNTY_ID")

shpm<- merge(myshp.points, myshp, by.x="id", by.y="CNTY_ID")

p <- ggplot(shpm, aes(long, lat, group=group, fill=NWBIR74))
p <- p + geom_polygon() + geom_path(color = "white") + coord_equal()

cities <- data.frame(long = c(-78.644722, -80.843333, -82.555833),
                    lat  = c( 35.818889, 35.226944, 35.58),
                    lab  = c("Raleigh", "Charlotte", "Asheville"))

p <- p + geom_point(aes(fill=NULL, group=NULL, group=lab),

data=cities, shape=3, size = 2, legend=F)

## Perfect!
p

HTH, 

B
